"The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian tourist who vanished into a sinkhole in Kuala Lumpur, has been halted due to safety concerns. She disappeared on August 23rd when a pavement gave way beneath her, causing her to fall into an 8-meter-deep cavity. Only her slippers have been recovered so far.

***

Despite an extensive operation involving tracker canines, remote imaging technology, and subsurface radar, no other evidence of her presence has been found. As the search entered its eighth day, the nation's fire and rescue organization declared it too hazardous to continue deploying divers into the hole.

***

Dr. Zaliha Mustafa, a minister in the prime minister's department, confirmed that the decision to suspend the operation was based on the well-being and security of the rescue crew members involved. This difficult decision underscores the extreme dangers present at the incident site.

***

Rescue personnel have attempted to clear parts of the subterranean drainage system using high-force water jets and heavy digging gear to remove obstructions. Two divers initially entered the sinkhole on Thursday, but were withdrawn quickly due to the perilous conditions before they could navigate past a particular obstruction.

***

Authorities have noted that this is not an isolated occurrence, as a ground movement event was documented at the same spot last year.

* The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali has been called off do to it being too risky for the rescuers.

Is there anything else I can help with?"
